content: Wordo Astamaareta

Gido attiin beni wode wordo nabeti dere giddon dizayssa mala hessaththoka ha7i intte giddon wordo astamaareti de7andettes; heytantti asa dhayssiza wordo timirte qotara diccana mala ooththeettes; bana ashshida Godaakka kaddidi bana eeson dhayssizaaz ba bolla eheettes.
Hessa gaason daro asay yeellachchiza istta ogeza kaallees; he istta oosoza gaason tumaa ogey cayettees.

Heyti wordo astamaareti miishshas gaphigaphiza gishshas barkka medhdhi ekkida yo7o yooti yootidi inttes dizaaz baas bonqqi ekkeettes; beni beniisoppe pirday isttas giigetti uttides; addafe istta dhayoy naagees.
Haray attoshin nagara ooththida kiitanchchatas Xoossi mishettontta istti ciimma gidida dhuma olla giddon de7idi pirda gallas gakkanaas naagettana mala gede gaannamen yeggides.

Hessaththoka xilloteththa gishshas sabaake gidida Nohe hankko laappun asatara ashshidi Xoossas goynnontta asati diza alameza bolla dhayssiza haaththe ehishe qadhettidi kase he wode alameza maaribeenna.
Qasseka Xoos goynnonttayta qaxxayanaas ubbaas leemiso gidana mala Sodoomeynne Gamoora katamati bidinth gidana gakkanaassinne xuugetti dhayana gakkanaas istta bolla pirdides.
Wogay baynda yeellachchiza ooso ooththiza asata ooson ubba wode so77u gishe diza xillo Looxe gidikko ashshi ekkides.
He xillo addezi istta giddon dishin gallas gallas izi be7izayssaninne siyizayssan he wogay baynda asata oosozan iza shemppoya waayettadus.

Histtiin hessi wurikka hessa mala gidikko Goday baas goynnishe diza asata paaceppe ashshanayssanne nagaranchchatakka wostti qaxxayanaakkonne pirda gallassas wostti istta naagidi gaththanaakko hessa izi erees guussa.

Harappeka heyti tuna gidida ba asho amo kaallizaytanne Xoossa Godateth kadhizayta pirda gallassas naagi woththides. Heyti wordo astamaareti istti xalatanne otoranchchata gidida gishshas salo bolla isttas godateththi dizayta cayishe babbettenna.
Kiitanchchati isttafe bollara wolqqaynne godateththi dizayta gidikkoka Godaa sinththan istta bolla kadhe qaala kessi mootettenna.

Heyti wordo astamaareti gidikko baas erettontta ixxida miish ubbaa cash cayeettes; heytantti narxan oykettanaassinne hayqqanaas yelettida; coo mela ba shenen dizaytanne qofay baynda do7ata mala; do7ati coo mela dhayzayssaththo isttika mulera dhayana.

Qoho ooso ooththida gishshas istti mulera ba ooso waaga ekkana; istta ufayssi seeta gallas maththoteththinne wogay baynda buraqo; istti hessa mala wogay baynda gufan inttenara issife xeygettiza wode as baleththiza ba asho oosozan istti iitanne yeellachchizayta.

Isttas nagara oosoppe naagettontta amottiza ayfey dees; isttas nagara ooso siiqiza amoteththi ay wodekka simmenna. Ammanon buro minni eqqontta asata baleththeettes; miishshas gaphigapheettes; istti qanggettidayta.
Istti suure ogeza aggidi dhayda; iita ooso ooththidi demmiza miish siiqida Bi7oore naa Bala7aame oge biidi balettida.
Bala7aamey gidikko ba ooththida nagara gishshas seerettides shin haasaya erontta hareya asa qaalan izas haasayada he nabeza balaappe seera zaaradus.
Heyti he asati haaththi baynda pulttota; gote carkon biza shaara mala; istta sakkanna dhumay naagees.
Kase bala garsan diza asata giddofe kessi ekki yiidi daro gam7ontta asata; hada gidida otoro qaala haasayan, asho amoninne layman baleththeettes.
«Intte wozzettana» gishe inttes ufays immeettes; xoonettida asi bana xoonidaades aylle gidi haarettizayssaththo isttika baas nagaras aylle.

Nu Godaanne nuna ashshida Yesus Kirstoosa eridi ha alameza tunateththaafe kessi ekkidaappe guye qasseka guye simmidi he kase tunateththaan xoonettidi gelikko isttas kaseyssafe guyeyssi aadho iita gidana.
Istti xilloteththa oge shaakki eridaappe guye isttas imettida geeshsha azazozappe guye simmanaappe istti kase he xilloteththa ogeza erontta aggidaakko isttas lo7okkoshin.
«Kanay ba cooyida cooshshaa maanaas guye simmees.» Hessaththoka, «Guddunththi meecettidi guye simmi urqqan genderettees» geetettiza tumu leemisoy istta bolla gakkides.
